evidence.text: Reason for referral: Evaluation of breathlessness on exertion in an 83-year-old man.

Findings: Normal sinus rhythm at 62 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 144 ms, QRS 81 ms, QTc
428 ms.
Impression: Normal sinus rhythm with voltage criteria for left ventricular hypertrophy.

Basic metabolic panel on discharge: sodium: 134 mmol/L, potassium: 5.1 mmol/L, creatinine:
1.4 mg/dL, BUN: 27 mg/dL, glucose: 118 mg/dL.

Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twicc daily
Tiotropium 18 mcg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: well appearing, no distress.
Neck: no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rae and rhythm, normalS1 and S2, no murmurs, rubs, or gallops.
Lungs: clear to auscultation bilaterally.
Extremities: no peripheral edema.
